tour.title: System Overview
tour.description: Start with the repo-level docs and stack entrypoints. These files explain what the product is, how the local stack runs, and where frontend and backend meet.

tour.title: Frontend Shell
tour.description: These Next.js files define the authenticated shell, dashboard routes, report views, and shared client-side state used across the UI.

tour.title: Frontend Data And Auth
tour.description: This group handles API calls, navigation safety, auth session state, and browser-side permission-aware behavior.

tour.title: Backend API
tour.description: The FastAPI application, auth dependency layer, stores, and artifact service live here. This is the main HTTP surface for upload, analysis, and report retrieval.

tour.title: Database Layer
tour.description: Database models, sessions, migrations, and local bootstrap logic define the persisted state used by auth, jobs, and artifacts.

tour.title: Analysis Engine
tour.description: The forensic engine and report pipeline live under backend/src. These modules perform packet analysis, evidence extraction, guardrails, and reporting.

tour.title: Workers And Runtime
tour.description: These files run the API server, worker process, batch tools, and container runtime configuration used in local and review environments.

tour.title: Tests And Review Assets
tour.description: This final pass shows backend tests, browser E2E coverage, and the fixture documentation used for verification and reviewer walkthroughs.

tour.title: Remaining Project Files
tour.description: These files round out the repo with supplementary docs, config, and implementation details that support the main product flow.
